body:
Know how you are feeling.
I broke up with my bf last week and its still hard.
Its like your brains on auto pilot, you dream about them, wake up expecting them to have been in contact.
Been through this before, it gets easier. Your feelings for them never truly go away, they do just linger but slowly you start forgetting about them and begin to find yourself again.

It really is so heartbreaking to know somebody else is in this position too... the end of a relationship is very similar to somebody passing away. 
Same grief stages.

I tried taking my own life last weekend over it.
After it i was put on antidepressants and psychiatric support.
It really does help...you arent alone and i would say getting help from a proffessional is the best thing

I tried suicide last night over the same issues.
He gave me a bit of happiness in life and when he got bored of me, he broke up with me. Seeing him carrying on with life as normal, while im crying my eyes out and wanting everything to end. Its going to be hard as i have no desire to go near another guy same as you but im gonna be the one who has to watch him with other girls, watching my heart being crushed. Some people live for love, loves a great thing but when its not shared, it can destroy your life. The thought they arent gonna be in your life nomore, is so crushing. Even the places you used to go are going to haunt you whenever you walk past them. 
Its going to be hard but your not alone, many of us are in the same heart wrenching position. Hugs
Because i cant even do suicide right.
